title: Executive Employment Agreement

origin.title: Superintendent Employment Agreement, approved July 1, 2025
origin.clearance_note: The executed superintendent employment agreement, posted for public access by the Bethlehem Central School District (Delmar, NY) and linked from its Employment Contracts page at https://www.bethlehemschools.org/employment-contracts/. Public-sector employment contracts are public records in New York. It is a wet-ink executed scan with an OCR text layer, signatures and notary acknowledgments. The operator chose not to redact it: all 13 pages are committed as the district filed them, including the superintendent's and board president's names, their signatures and the notaries' details on pages 12 and 13. This departs from the collection's usual rule of replacing personal data before parsing, by the operator's explicit decision on 2026-10-28. Only the PDF's document metadata (/Info, XMP and structure tree) was cleared; the page content is untouched. The featured fields are all impersonal terms of the contract.

notes: Page 2 carries the commercial core of the contract: the five-year term, the first-year base salary, the 4.0% annual increase and the longevity schedule, so one overlay reads as the deal itself. The request suggested exactly this page and these terms. Base salary and the annual increase are pinned to their second occurrence, the numeric forms ($235,553.00 and 4.0%), because the first occurrence grounds to the spelled-out salary line, which does not contain the figure. Of the three longevity payments the $7,500 one is featured, since its grounded line carries the amount and its effective date together. No personal name is featured, by design: the role is enough to tell the story.
